title: Running Commentary on Torah 40 — Eileh Mas'ei B'nei Yisrael
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 40 — אלה מסעי בני ישראל
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **"It is brought in **Asarah Ma'amaros**: **'Eileh mas'ei b'nei Yisrael'** (Bamidbar 33:1) — 'bi'shvil she'chat'u b'eileh (Elokecha Yisrael — the **eigel**), bi'shvil zeh yis'u b'nei Yisrael.'** Thus **all of a person's travels are due to blemished emunah** = bechina of **avodah zarah**. Had he **complete emunah** that HKBH can provide all his needs, he wouldn't travel at all. Therefore **nesi'ah = pgam emunah = AZ**. And regarding AZ it is written: **'tzei tomar lo'** (Yeshayahu 30:22) — **'tzei' = nesi'ah v'tiltul**. Via tiltul, **rogez** is aroused (**'ro'gzu v'al techeta'u,'** Tehillim 4:5) — the traveler is **shaken from his inner peace** by the tiltul itself, like Lot's exile for chet of AZ. Every nesi'ah is thus a **tikkun for pgam emunah**: the very difficulty of the road forces emunah back to its root. When emunah is fully restored → no more mas'a. Hence **last parshiyos of Bamidbar = 42 mas'os** = the great **tikkun of emunah through the midbar**, which was the **kelalus of all galus-journeys** until emunah shleimah is established."**

intermediate.en: **"Eileh mas'ei b'nei Yisrael"** (Bam 33:1; Asarah Ma'amaros): chat'u b'eileh→yis'u. All travels=**pgam emunah=AZ**. Complete emunah→no travel. "Tzei tomar lo" (Yesh 30:22)=nesi'ah/tiltul (of AZ). Tiltul arouses rogez (Teh 4:5) = shaking shakes loose to force return to emunah. 42 mas'os=tikkun emunah through midbar=kelalus galus.
intermediate.he: **"אלה מסעי בני ישראל"** (במ' לג, א; עשרה מאמרות): חטאו באלה→יסעו. כל נסיעה=**פגם אמונה=ע"ז**. אמונה שלמה→אין נסיעה. "צא תאמר לו" (יש' ל, כב)=נסיעה/טלטול (של ע"ז). טלטול מעורר רוגז (תה' ד, ה). מ"ב מסעות=תיקון אמונה במדבר=כלל הגלות.

scholarly.he: במ' לג, א; עשרה מאמרות; יש' ל, כב; תה' ד, ה.
